description: This Java class defines HtmlMenuWrapperImage, a subclass of HtmlMenuWrapper, used for rendering HTML menus with images in the OFBiz framework. It handles initialization by querying entity data related to website publish points and provides a specific menu renderer implementation.

classes.name: HtmlMenuWrapperImage
classes.description: A specialized HTML menu wrapper class for menus with images, extending HtmlMenuWrapper, with methods to initialize menu items with associated content from the database.

methods.name: HtmlMenuWrapperImage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with resource name, menu name, request, and response objects.

methods.name: getMenuRenderer
methods.description: Returns an instance of HtmlMenuRendererImage to render the menu with images.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the menu wrapper, retrieves related content IDs for each menu item, queries the WebSitePublishPoint entities, and stores them in the context.
